sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:30 – 14:30)
items: Equipment received: 2 x Swipe Cards, 5 sets of keys, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 1 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
Guard arrived; commencing debriefing and gearing up.
Welfare check at Localito, Queen Street McDonald's and the 77 Convenience Store, all clear. Standing by for security presence.
Arrived at the corner of Queen Street and Shortland Street; continuing towards Fort Street.
Fort Street and all surrounding businesses, from The Right Track through to the Coffee Club, all clear. Standing by for security presence.
Gore Street all clear, including Auckland Harbour Suites. Standing by for security presence.
Arrived at Commercial Bay; commencing a sweep of the area.
Still at Commercial Bay maintaining presence.
Maintaining presence due to heavy foot traffic.
Full sweep conducted at Commercial Bay; welfare check on all businesses, all clear.
Lower Albert Street all clear, no issues; patrolling up Albert Street.
Welfare check at Albert Mart, all clear, no issues.
Albert Street all clear; patrolling through Swanson Street to Federal Square.
Swanson Street all clear; arrived at Federal Square, sweeping the area.
Full sweep conducted at Federal Square; welfare check at the cathedral, Liston House and Hotel Indigo, all clear, no issues.
Federal Square all clear, no issues.
Welfare check at the 77 Convenience Store and all businesses in the area, all clear, no issues.
Full sweep of Victoria Street West; patrolling Elliott Street.
Swept Elliott Street; welfare check at the Elliott carpark, Domino's, the Indian cuisine restaurant and The Fresh Market, all clear, no issues.
Welfare check at the Elliott Atrium, Elliott Stables and the Mid City entrance, all clear, no issues.
Full sweep of Darby Street; welfare check at Pizza Club, Mali Thai, Celines and Lumi Cafe, all clear, no issues. Standing by at the Ippondo entrance maintaining presence in the area.
Received a call from the Cathedral church on Wyndham Street about a vagrant causing a disturbance; heading there now.

Arrived; mass was in progress. Spoke to one of the deacons, who explained where the incident occurred, and then to the Father running the donation centre downstairs, where the vagrant had been seen. He described a female vagrant calling herself Serenity, plus another alias the team could not make out. Stood by at the Cathedral; the Father asked about the team's job and jurisdiction and hoped more patrols would join to achieve quicker response times. Heading upstairs to stand by for security presence.
Heading through Federal Street to the office to use the restroom.
While walking down Victoria Street, members of the public reported a suspicious person in the Elliott Carpark staying near people's cars and trying to open their doors; heading there now.

Arrived; the person of interest had left. Another member of the public approached the team after seeing us in the carpark and provided a recording of the person; footage retrieved. (Footage on file.) Standing by for security presence.
Arrived at the office; it is raining, so seeking shelter.
Heading back on patrol towards High Street via Victoria Street; still raining, patrolling under covered areas and moving when able to.
Stores on High Street from the Brand Warehouse down to Barkers all clear. Heading towards Chancery Square via O'Connell Street; will also check Freyberg Square.
Arrived at Chancery Square and completed a sweep; all stores all clear. Freyberg Square all clear too. Standing by for security presence.
Heading through Lorne Street for the check-in.
All stores on Lorne Street all clear, no issues to report. Heading to the office for a 30-minute break.
Received a call from the 77 Convenience Store at the corner of Victoria and Federal Streets about a vagrant yelling; heading there now.
Arrived at the location; approached the male vagrant and kindly asked him to leave. Standing by until the vagrant leaves and maintaining presence at the 77 Convenience Store.
Welfare check at the 77 Convenience Store, all clear, no issues; heading back to Headquarters for a 10-minute break.
Arrived at Headquarters; commencing a 10-minute break.
Charging the Ops Phone due to low percentage; standing by for shift changeover and will respond to calls.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:30)
items: Equipment received: 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 2 x Radio, 2 x Bodycam, 1 x Swipe Key.
Ops Phone charged at HQ due to low percentage before commencing patrols.
Standing by awaiting the second guard.
Received a call from Ethan about a male individual under the influence of alcohol yelling and being aggressive outside Cotton On; heading to respond.
Arrived at Cotton On; council wardens outside briefed the team that an intoxicated male accompanied by a young girl had been threatening people. Police are also on scene.

Brought the person of interest out and spoke with Police to coordinate — the team acting as first responders with Police as the last resort. His daughter is 13 years old and the intention was to avoid traumatising her with the sight of her father being locked up for public intoxication, so the team will observe. Visual on the male was lost while speaking with Police; heading to locate him.
No sign of the person of interest or his child from the stores at Mecca and Farmers down to Vulcan Lane; stores all clear of issues. Heading to check Chancery Square.
Checked Chancery Square and the High Street businesses; no sign of the person of interest. Heading back down towards the Queen Street and Victoria Street intersection.
Standing by at the Starbucks corner in case the person of interest returns.
No signs of the person of interest.
Received a response call from Britomart McDonald's regarding a group of protesters standing in front of the store, being loud and disturbing customers going in and out.
Arrived at the location; the protesters have quietened down. Welfare check at Britomart McDonald's; standing by showing presence.
All clear, no issues to report; continuing patrol.
Police arresting a male on lower Queen Street; standing by showing presence and ready to assist if needed.
All clear, no issues to report; Police have now left. Continuing patrols through Commercial Bay.
Commencing a full sweep of Commercial Bay with welfare checks in the area.
All clear, no issues to report; continuing patrol up Queen Street.
Full sweep of Durham Street, all clear, no issues to report; continuing patrol towards Aotea Square.
Welfare check at Queen Street McDonald's, all clear, no issues to report; continuing patrol towards Aotea Square.
Arrived at Aotea Square; commencing a full sweep of the area.
All clear, no further issues; standing by showing presence to the public while awaiting response calls.
All clear, no further issues; commencing patrol.
Patrolling through Elliott Street; welfare check at Elliott Stables, standing by showing presence.
All clear, no issues to report; continuing patrol down Elliott Street with welfare checks at St Pierre's Sushi, the Elliott carpark and Woolworths Victoria Street.
Heading to HQ to start a 30-minute break.
Arrived at Headquarters; starting a 30-minute break.
The Headquarters door is not closing; standing by.
Still outside Headquarters waiting for the doors to be closed.
Heading up to Headquarters to charge the Ops Phone, which is on 12%.
Afternoon Shift concluded; handing over to the Night Shift.

sections.title: Night Shift (22:30 – 06:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.

The Afternoon Shift notified the team that the main-entrance automatic doors are faulty — they will not close or open. Staff have tried calling Hussy and Ravi about the issue. The team has been told to disregard the doors, despite the risk of intrusion, and carry on with the usual schedule.
Standing by to guard the door until the foot traffic dies down; moderate foot traffic in the area currently. To minimise risk, standing by while awaiting response calls in the meantime.
The area has quietened down a little; the main entrance will be checked throughout the night. Commencing patrols, heading down Queen Street.
Wyndham Street all clear; foot traffic is dying down at this time.
Conducting a sweep down Vulcan Lane.
Vulcan Lane all clear; moving along.
Conducting a sweep down Shortland Street.
Shortland Street all clear; moving along.
Arrived at Commercial Bay; commencing checks in the area.
Sweep completed; welfare check at McDonald's Britomart. Standing by awaiting response calls.
Britomart McDonald's and TK Square all clear; no issues to report thus far. Moving along.
Fort Lane and Fort Street all clear; heading up High Street.
Arrived at Freyberg Square; conducting a sweep.
Freyberg Square all clear; vagrants occupying the area, no other issues to report. Moving along.
Received a call from Queen Street McDonald's regarding a suspicious male in store frequenting the toilet and acting suspiciously overall; heading to the location.
The male has been removed from the premises; video footage obtained. (Footage on file.) Continuing patrols from the last point.
Arrived at Lorne Street and Victoria Street East; the area appears vacant. Continuing up Lorne Street.
Lorne Street all clear; conducting a sweep at the Auckland City Library.
Auckland City Library all clear; vagrants sleeping in the area. Heading towards Aotea Square.
Arrived at Aotea Square; conducting a sweep and standing by awaiting response calls in the area.
Aotea Square all clear, no issues in the area; heading back to HQ to check the main entrance and conduct floor checks.
Main entrance all clear; conducting floor checks.
Victoria Street West all clear; conducting a sweep of Albert Street.
Albert Street all clear; Skymart welfare check.
77 Convenience Store welfare check, all clear; conducting a sweep on Federal Street.
Federal Street all clear; heading down Wellesley Street West towards Elliott Street.
Conducting a sweep on Elliott Street.
The Atrium all clear; carpark all clear; Darby Street also. Heading back down Queen Street.
Conducting a sweep at Commercial Bay; standing by awaiting response calls.
Commercial Bay all clear; Britomart McDonald's all clear, no issues.
Albert Street all clear, no issues.
Mayoral Drive all clear, no issues.
Myers Street all clear, no issues.
Arrived at Aotea Square; commencing a sweep.
Aotea Square sweep completed; heading back to Headquarters to charge the Ops Phone.
Standing by at the main entrance to ensure security; awaiting the morning team.
Handover completed with the morning team.

flags: CAPACITY: 10:21 Cathedral (Wyndham Street) call — 26 minutes to on-scene (10:47); the attending Father explicitly asked for more patrol coverage to achieve quicker response times.

SENSITIVE: 14:42–15:43 intoxicated male threatening people outside Cotton On with his 13-year-old daughter present; Police and council wardens on scene; the team coordinated with Police to avoid an arrest in front of the child; visual was lost and the person of interest was not relocated.
GAP: Afternoon log has no entries between 15:43 and 17:45 (~2 hours unaccounted for).

BUILDING: HQ main-entrance automatic doors faulty from 20:14 — would not close or open; the afternoon team was held at the door 20:14–21:23, and the night team was instructed to disregard the fault despite the intrusion risk, checking the entrance periodically instead.
TIME: 23:37 'Arrived at Commercial Bay' logged out of sequence after the 23:40 Shortland Street entry (likely 23:47); kept in narrative order as written.
NOTE: Afternoon equipment list differs from the standard issue (no Ops Phone listed; 2 x Bodycam, 1 x Swipe Key) — copied verbatim from the raw log.
